description: This Java class implements a CoAP server service with support for DTLS, including server initialization, shutdown, and session management.

classes.name: DefaultCoapServerService
classes.description: A service class managing a CoAP server with optional DTLS support, including server lifecycle and session eviction.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the CoAP server upon bean creation.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the server and associated executors.

methods.name: getCoapServer
methods.description: Returns the existing CoapServer instance or creates a new one if null.

methods.name: getDtlsSessionsMap
methods.description: Provides access to the current DTLS sessions map.

methods.name: createCoapServer
methods.description: Configures and starts the CoAP server with network and security settings.

methods.name: isDtlsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if DTLS is enabled based on server context.

methods.name: getDtlsSessionReportTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves the timeout value for DTLS session reporting.
